sections.heading: Grounded answers
sections.text: The performance coach should answer operational questions only when the response can be grounded in approved knowledge available to the user's role. Unsupported answers are refused rather than guessed.

sections.heading: Sensitive data
sections.text: Users must not enter sensitive personal, patient, credential, or confidential identity data into the performance coach. Requests for such data are redirected to approved enterprise systems and privacy processes.
